bullets: On Thursday 19 November, DLD recorded 521 sales worth AED 1.4bn, up 9.5% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 54.3% of the total, while the 7-day average was 59.0%.
The median price was AED 1,690 per sq ft, up 0.7% against the 30-day average and down 3.9% year-on-year.
Over the past 7 days, the busiest areas were JVC with 192 sales, Saih Shuaib 1 with 133 sales, and Business Bay with 129 sales.
In October new rental contracts, JVC 1BR apartments had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: The Dubai Metro Blue Line construction has reached 29 to 30 percent completion, which improves local connectivity and property values.
Nakheel generated 1.5 billion dollars at a recent launch, demonstrating strong investor demand in Dubai.
Nakheel also raised Dh5.5 billion from Palm Springs villa sales, highlighting strong buyer demand for family properties.
